title: 第21章  铁布衫功力反馈第22章  试药
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
“三倍时间流速？那在这待78天，现实不得过去小一个月？
这可太耽误事了，那天一武院的招聘会去不成也就算了。
第一高中的毕业典礼不也没得去了？多好的人前显圣的机会啊！”
苏青啧啧嘴，有些可惜的摇了摇头。
虽然有些遗憾，但孰轻孰重他还是分得清的。
为不耽误时间，立刻着手给铁牛安排修行环境。
自己构建场景，费时费力，效果还未必好。
抱着从简从快的原则，他在武道圣胎的环境库里挑选了几个现成的，稍加改动之后，就能拿出来给铁牛用了。
这些环境怎么说呢。
那是相当残忍了！
但没办法，铁布衫就是一门笨功夫，苦功夫，不熬不炼，成不了材。
“银背蚁林，你别看这些银背蚁咬人又酸又痒，但万蚁噬咬，炼体又炼心啊！
从银背蚁林出来之后，再去风火雷池，些许风霜，几缕雷火，相信自己，你受得住的！
最后，再去甲戈战场磨练下，沙场厮杀最能磨砺钢铁意志，刀枪无眼更能炼出铁血男儿！”
按照他对铁牛以及铁布衫的了解，苏青把铁牛这78天的修炼安排的明明白白。
就是铁牛脸色吓得煞白。
但马上又坚定了意志。
他娘说过，阿苏脑子灵，听他的准没错，尤其他现在还是创武师，武学方面的事，更得听他的了。
看铁牛这模样，苏青也起了恻隐之心。
心软的减少了些银背蚁数量，削弱了雷火强度，以及给沙场厮杀的血腥画面打了些马赛克。

“痛觉感知就不调了，要不然起不到淬炼武道意志的作用。”
“嗯，我都听你的，其实按最高强度来，我也挺得住的，只要对你对我好，我怎么着都成！”
“带点能量药水跟包子肉干进去，在这里虽然疲劳伤势都能迅速恢复，但肉身所需能量还是要从外界获取的。”
“嗯，我们一人一半，我功力反馈给你后，你也要吃的。”
“真受不了也不要强撑，你喊停，就可以出来。”
“只要吃的够，我不会停的！”
铁牛坚定表态。
他虽然才十六七岁，也不是真的铁牛，还是个人。
也会怕痛，怕疼，怕被人锤。
但他看过傅佳佳为做苏青武徒有多卑微，也明白能进这武道圣胎修行的机会有多难得。
不用苏青过多叮嘱，他就知道自己应该在这里全力以赴。
重重的跟苏青点了点头，他伸手摸向那银色透明的水晶球。
这水晶球里，正是银背蚁林空间。
苏青看到，铁牛跟其一接触，马上就出现在蚁林中。
无数只银色蚂蚁，迅速朝他身上爬来，尖锐的口器，在他浑身上下啃噬撕咬。
作为一个旁观者，苏青都感觉头皮发麻。
里面的铁牛却只是在才开始发出了几声闷哼，而后便专注运行铁布衫功法。
与此同时，他的身体也有些异样。
肌肤表里有蚊虫叮咬之感，筋骨爆响有撕裂般剧痛，气血鼓荡，五脏轰鸣。
他明白，这是铁牛修行的功力，正在反馈到他身上。

因双方体质不同，铁牛修行铁布衫所得收获，他这孱弱身体承受起来有些吃力。
因此，在这个过程中，他肯定是要受些罪的。
content_en:
"Three times the time flow rate? Then if you stay here for 78 days, the reality will not be less than a month?
This would be too much of a delay. It would be fine if I couldn't go to the job fair at Yiwuyuan that day.
Don’t we have to go to the graduation ceremony of First High School? What a wonderful opportunity to appear before others! "
Su Qing clicked her tongue and shook her head with some pity.
Although he was a little regretful, he could still tell which was more important.
In order not to waste time, he immediately started arranging a training environment for Tieniu.
Constructing the scene yourself is time-consuming and labor-intensive, and the effect may not be good.
Adhering to the principle of simplicity and quickness, he selected a few ready-made ones from the environment library of the Martial Arts Saint Fetus. After making slight changes, he could use them for Tieniu.
What to say about these environments.
That is quite cruel!
But there is no way, the iron cloth shirt is just a stupid skill, hard work, no hard work, no practice, no talent.
"Silver-backed ant forest, don't look at the bite of these silver-backed ants, which is sore and itchy, but the bites of thousands of ants are refining the body and mind!
After coming out of the Silverback Ant Forest, go to the Wind, Fire and Thunder Pond. A little wind and frost, and a few wisps of thunder and fire. Believe in yourself, you can handle it!
Finally, go to the Jia Ge battlefield for training. Fighting on the battlefield can best sharpen your iron will, and swords and guns without eyes can even make an iron-blooded man! "
Based on his understanding of Tieniu and Tiebushan, Su Qing clearly arranged Tieniu's 78 days of training.
It was Tieniu whose face turned pale with fright.
But he immediately strengthened his will.
His mother said that Asu was smart and it was right to listen to him, especially since he was still a creative martial arts master, so he had to listen to him even more when it came to martial arts.
Seeing Tieniu's appearance, Su Qing also felt compassion.
He soft-heartedly reduced the number of silverback ants, weakened the intensity of thunder and fire, and mosaic the bloody scenes of battlefield fighting.
"The pain perception will not be adjusted, otherwise it will not be able to temper the martial arts will."
"Well, I listen to you. In fact, even if you apply it to the highest intensity, I can withstand it. As long as I'm good to you and me, I can do whatever I want!"
"Bring some energy potions and steamed buns with dried meat. Although fatigue and injuries can be recovered quickly here, the energy needed for the physical body still needs to be obtained from the outside world."
"Well, each of us will take half. After my power is fed back to you, you will also have to eat."
"If you really can't stand it, don't force yourself. Just say stop and you can come out."
"As long as I eat enough, I won't stop!"
Tieniu made a firm statement.
Although he is only sixteen or seventeen years old, he is not really an iron bull, he is still a human being.
I am also afraid of pain, pain, and being hammered.
But he had seen how humble Fu Jiajia was to become Su Qing's martial disciple, and he also understood how rare the opportunity was to enter this martial arts holy embryo.
Without Su Qing's exhortation, he knew that he should go all out here.
Nodding heavily to Su Qing, he reached out and touched the silver transparent crystal ball.
In this crystal ball, it is the space of the Silverback Ant Forest.
Su Qing saw that Tieniu immediately appeared in the ant forest as soon as he came into contact with him.
Countless silver ants quickly crawled towards him, biting and biting all over his body with their sharp mouthparts.
As a bystander, Su Qing felt his scalp numb.
The Tieniu inside just started to make a few muffled grunts, and then concentrated on running the Tiebushan technique.
At the same time, there was something strange about his body.
There is a feeling of mosquito bites on the surface and inside of the skin, there is a sharp pain like tearing in the muscles and bones, qi and blood are surging, and the five internal organs are roaring.
He understood that this was Tieniu's cultivation skills, which were being fed back to him.
Due to the different physiques of the two parties, it was difficult for Tieniu's weak body to bear the gains he gained from practicing the Iron Cloth Shirt.
Therefore, he must suffer some pain in the process.
